description: Find probable high-motion moments in a bounded local video sample from decoded frame differences. Read-only editorial candidates; camera movement, flashes, cuts, and subject motion are not semantically distinguished.

minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum peak spacing from 0.1 through 30 seconds (default: 1)

samples_per_second.description: Frame samples per second from 1 through 10 (default: 4)

threshold.description: Minimum mean luma-frame difference from 0 through 255 (default: 12)

name: detect_motion_peaks

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Detect Motion Peaks
